text:
Maya Ruiz: Heads-up  were seeing failures in initial index jobs for a subset of EU onboarding tenants (webhook retries + 401). Eng investigating. Need comms + renewal triage.

Jon Park: How big is the cohort and any near-term renewals?

Maya Ruiz: About 29 tenants affected, 5 with renewals in the 45-90 day window. DMing list to Rina and CS leads.

Rina Shah: For renewals: offer live enablement + account credit and prioritize scheduling. Draft two short templates (technical & exec).

Maya Ruiz: Draft technical (send now):
Hi <Name>,
Were investigating an issue impacting webhook delivery and the initial embedding step for a small set of EU onboarding customers. Symptoms: repeated webhook retries and authorization errors, which can delay index readiness.
Mitigation: we can enable a temporary hosted fallback to complete onboarding with your consent, or pause and retry after fix. Well apply a credit for impacted jobs. Please reply to confirm preference. RCA due within 72 hours.
Thanks,
<CS rep>

Jon Park: Make sure opt-in link + consent checkbox included. Legal ok on credits?

Maya Ruiz: Legal signoff pending  checking now.

IncidentBot: Incident IND-2026-05-EU-ONB created. Status: investigating. ETA for mitigation plan T+5h.

Rina Shah: Action items: 1) send tech message to cohort ASAP, 2) flag renewals and do high-touch outreach, 3) offer fallback opt-in and schedule enablement sessions, 4) log outcomes in the tracking sheet (columns: renewal_risk, opt_in, session_scheduled, credit_applied).

Maya Ruiz: Sending batch now. Will update when we have opt-in uptake and legal credit approval. Last update ts: 1715804510.
